title: Linux: Clipboard randomly stops working until editor is restarted
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.beta.custom_build [f20ef37cc]
- Has been occurring for some time in 4.5, unsure about 4.4.

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (f20ef37cc) - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 07 Aug 2025 04:47:58 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 30.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

While working in the editor, at some point (conditions unclear), Godot cannot use the clipboard anymore. For instance, copying and pasting code within the script editor fails (cutting with <kbd>Ctrl + X</kbd> does erase the text, but <kbd>Ctrl + V</kbd> does not paste the cut text). Copying from Godot to other apps does not work, and pasting from other apps to Godot doesn't work either (but other apps can still use the clipboard).

I use the Wayland editor, I don't know if X11 editor and/or session also have this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

Unclear to me, see WAYLAND_DEBUG log below.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP, but here is a WAYLAND_DEBUG log file from a session where the issue occurred. The file was cleaned a bit from 1.5 million lines to the first 10k and the last ~50k lines. If more than those 50k are needed, I can add them (the entire file is ~9MB compressed).

[clipboard_issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21966877/clipboard_issue.zip)
